title: Easy algebraization of a formal coherent module up to ideal-power torsion
statement: Let X be a Noetherian scheme [pqf-def-locnoeth], let I be a quasi-coherent ideal sheaf on X, let G be a coherent O_X-module [pqf-def-coherent], and let (F_n) be an object of Coh(X,I) [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module]. (1) If alpha:(F_n) -> G^ is a morphism whose kernel and cokernel are annihilated by a power of I [lem-weil-pbc-formal-systems-annihilated-by-power], then there are a coherent O_X-module F, a map a:F -> G whose kernel and cokernel are annihilated by a power of I, and an isomorphism beta:(F_n) -> F^ such that alpha = a^ beta; the triple is unique up to unique isomorphism. (2) If instead alpha:G^ -> (F_n) has kernel and cokernel annihilated by a power of I, then there are a coherent O_X-module F, a map a:G -> F whose kernel and cokernel are annihilated by a power of I, and an isomorphism beta:F^ -> (F_n) such that alpha = beta a^; this triple is unique up to unique isomorphism.

source.place: Cohomology of Schemes, Lemma 0889 (lemma-existence-easy), line 6487 and proof lines 6504--6550
